item.title: “I Hope I Show It’s Possible”: Natalie Portman Wants A Vegan Future For Fashion
item.description: Natalie Portman is backing Uncaged Innovations’s vegan leather alternative, Elevate, after joining the company as strategic partner. Read on for more on Natalie Portman’s hopes for a vegan future for fashion.

item.title: Kate Middleton Wears Winter’s Trending Colour For Her Annual Christmas Carol Service
item.description: Kate Middleton, the Princess of Wales, rewore a forest-green coat dress by Catherine Walker for the 2025 Together at Christmas carol service at Westminster Abbey. Kate Middleton was joined by Prince William and their three children, Prince George, Princess Charlotte and Prince Louis.

item.title: Sienna Miller’s Pregnancy Wardrobe Reminds Us That Leopard Print Is A Neutral
item.description: Noughties icon Sienna Miller is back to remind us why she’s next stopped being our style obsession. In head-to-toe leopard, the star’s maternity wardrobe is doubling up as Christmas party inspo.

item.title: A Graceful Manner And A Rock Star Glamour: Christine Baranski On The Great Tom Stoppard
item.description: “He wore the mantle of his fame lightly, rather like a cashmere scarf tossed around his neck,” recalls Baranski, who won a Tony for her role as Charlotte in Tom Stoppard’s “The Real Thing.” “We will not see the likes of him again.”

item.title: This London Designer Blurred The Boundaries Of Fashion And Art In A Steamy, Sapphic Performance
item.description: In the depths of The Barbican Centre, Sinéad O'Dwyer presented a movement piece that explored the kinky characters of her autumn/winter 2025 collection and fashion’s inherent sensuality.

item.title: Having A Baby In Your Forties Is A Good Thing, Actually
item.description: “There is so much to celebrate about being pregnant in your late thirties and forties,” writes Nell Frizzell. “I was happier, more confident, more content and better resourced than I think I would have been two decades earlier.”

item.title: Carolina Cucinelli On How To Have A Quiet Luxury Christmas
item.description: Few are as familiar with luxury as Carolina Cucinelli, co-creative director of Brunello Cucinelli. As the über-luxe label takes over Harrods’ festive window display, she shares what a Cucinelli Christmas looks like – and how you can have one, too.

item.title: Why Do I Feel So Blue After Socialising?
item.description: Amelia Tait noticed that she often felt sad after nights out, regardless of how much fun she had. Here, she speaks to psychologists and neuroscientists about why.

item.title: How To Throw A Wedding In 2026, According To These Celebrity Planners
item.description: Vogue asked their experts for the top tips on how to plan a wedding, from ensuring it’s personal to you to being realistic about your budget from the start. Read on for Vogue’s guide on how to plan a wedding.

item.title: The Best Puffer Jackets & Coats To Buy For Autumn/Winter 2025
item.description: Consider a puffer jacket as the perfect outerwear solution for winter 2025. From Arket to Uniqlo; Gucci and 66 North – these are the best puffer jackets and coats to wear now.
